title: 12 mayoral candidates sign sustainability pledges ahead of elections
summary: Taipei, Oct. 12 (CNA) Twelve candidates in Taiwan's upcoming local government elections have signed pledges to promote sustainable and resilient policies if elected, civic groups said Monday.

title: PLA drills not close to Taiwan: Defense Minister Koo
summary: Taipei, Oct. 12 (CNA) Defense Minister Wellington Koo (顧立雄) said Monday that Taiwan is closely monitoring China's military exercises in the region and has assessed that the latest round will be held off the coast of China rather than near Taiwan.
